comment: Composite indexes Firestore can't infer. Deploy with:
Everything else in this codebase sorts in memory precisely to avoid needing
indexes; the entries here exist where reading a whole collection would cost
a document read per stored row on every page load.

indexes.comment: Inbox: newest-N received mail. Without this, GET /api/emails/messages reads EVERY message a provider has ever received, on every load and every live refresh.
Learning Hub parent digest (server/src/lib/hubDigestStore.ts): a child's attempts since a cutoff (range on submittedAt ASC). Needed by GET /digest/preview and POST /digest/run.
Learning Hub: a student's attempts, newest first (docs/learning-hub.md). The API currently sorts in memory, so this only matters once a child has many attempts.
Learning Hub: a student's flashcard schedule, soonest due first. The API currently reads a child's reviews and splits due/new in memory.
Learning Hub: a provider's live lessons in time order. The API currently reads a tenant's lessons and filters in memory.
Dashboard: the runs with a session still to come. Without this, GET /api/dashboard reads every block the tenant has ever run, on every load.
Dashboard 'new this week' (and any other recent-bookings window). Without this it reads every booking the tenant has ever taken to count seven days of them.
Dashboard 'taken this week' — settled card/offline payments by the date the money landed. Pairs with the createdAt index below (a record has one or the other).
Dashboard 'taken this week' — payment records that never got a paidAt (offline records are stamped createdAt only).
